notes.title: Version 1.3.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]New:[/h2]
Added option to turn XInput off for players that want more than 4 controllers.
Go to Settings > Controllers > Toggle XInput On / Off
(With XInput off you may find triggers do not behave correctly with some controllers however you can also grab using the bumpers which appear unaffected)


[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Tiny Teams Festival. August 9th - 15th
notes.content:
Hot off our launch on Thursday August 6th we are super excited to announce that Drink More Glurp will also be a part of The Yogscast Tiny Teams Festival, celebrating games developed by core teams of 1-3 people! 

It is going to be an amazing week, we are super honoured to be sharing space with some truly amazing indie teams! There will be special offers and live streams all week.

One of the hardest parts of game dev, especially for tiny teams like us, is visibility and getting your game in front of people that might like it. We hope the festival will give people a chance to check out some awesome games that they may not normally have found otherwise!

The festival starts at 8pm (BST) on August 9th over at [url=http://twitch.tv/yogscast ]http://twitch.tv/yogscast [/url] 

Cheers

notes.title: Drink More Glurp Out Now!
notes.content:
Dust off those controllers and get ready for some party game madness... sponsored by Glurp!

Drink More Glurp is out now:

[list]
[*] Local multiplayer - hot seat - for up to 20 players
[*] All you need is one controller - or you can attach multiple controllers
[*] Thousands of possible event and brand combinations
[*] Sponsors randomly appear and twist the events to suit their agenda
[/list]

Also includes a single player challenge mode with online leaderboards and replays!

We hope you enjoy playing together and laughing at each other flailing about.


Come join us on Discord if you want to chat to us about our mad game: https://discord.gg/8qP8XuM

notes.title: Attempt a 20 player alien Olympics in Drink More Glurp, out today
notes.content:
Drink More Glurp

is a game about aliens who simply do not understand the Olympics. They think that it’s all about paid sponsorships, and as a result, their sponsors have weirded-up all the events, making it so these poor aliens have to deal with increasingly bizarre competitions. Now, when I say aliens I mean you, because they’re who you play as in this quirky party game. It’s no small fry sports competition either, ‘cos you can play it locally with up to 20 people. 20!

notes.title: Play Drink More Glurp in the Steam Game Festival and chat with the devs
notes.content:
[b]About the demo:[/b]
Hey there! We hope you enjoy this taster of Drink More Glurp, with limited options and content to tickle your fancy.

Drink More Glurp is a local multiplayer party game for up to 20 local players. We also have a single player Challenge mode with online leaderboards and replays. 

Compete to be top of the leaderboards against your friends and players from around the world. Watch back replays to learn from your fellow athletes.

The demo includes only a small sample of the events, sponsors and challenges that will be available at launch.

Drink More Glurp will be out this Summer! 

We understand that local multiplayer is tough right now, given the global pandemic. We hope that soon, when it is safe to do so, we can all get together again to play silly multiplayer games in the same room as friends and family. 

Hopefully some of you are in a place where you can play with others, but if not we have the single player Challenge mode where you can go for gold or you can play Party Mode with friends and family over Steam Remote Play (your results may vary however depending on connection speed).

[b]A bit about us:[/b]
We are CATASTROPHIC_OVERLOAD, a game dev duo based in Bristol, UK. Josh does the code and James does the graphics.

Given our shared love of local multiplayer and the role it played in us coming together, it made perfect sense for us to have this at the heart of Drink More Glurp. Local multiplayer is the reason we met and now the reason we make games.

[b]Come hang out in our Discord:[/b]
Got questions about Glurp? We have a handy Discord where you can come ask us questions and make suggestions like what hats you would like to see in the game... always need more hats!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/8qP8XuM]Join us on Discord[/url]

notes.title: Drink More Glurp Jingle Jam Challenge
notes.content:
This year Glurp has teamed up with the folks over at Yogscast and Humble Bundle to bring you the ultimate Jingle Jam Challenge. You could win a Switch and a copy of Drink More Glurp at launch, a tasty Glurp merch bundle and even a medal!

Compete for the top scores in a series of challenges with global leaderboards! Watch back replays of the other competitors to see how your mad techniques stack up.

This is an exclusive competition edition of Drink More Glurp, only available in the Jingle Jam bundle!

[b]Get the best combined rank in all the challenges and you will win the top prize!!![/b]

[b]2nd and 3rd place will also get a lovely merch bundle![/b]

Within the bundle you will also get access to a bunch of amazing games! 100% of the proceeds go to charity. 

[url=https://drinkmoreglurp.com/jinglejam/]Visit our website to find out more about the Jingle Jam Challenge[/url]

Competition closes at midnight on the 22nd December 2019!
Full competition terms and conditions are available [url=https://drinkmoreglurp.com/jinglejam-termsandconditions]here[/url]. UK and EU residents aged 16 and above only.

notes.title: The First Annual RPS Olympics at EGX Rezzed 2019
notes.content:
EGX Rezzed is a cavern of knowledge and wonder. Distinguished veterans descend monklike into its depths, prepared to discuss topics as diverse as the psychology of game addiction, the design of fictional languages, and the financial viability of small studios. Some people, though, are too refined even for such rarified chat. Some people spent Rezzed goofing around in stupid local multiplayer games, hollering their own names and donking back tins of novelty soft drinks in the Leftfield room. Those people were the RPS Olympians, and they re about to take a hard ninety degree turn into the first person plural, because they were staff writer Matt Cox, guides person Dave Irwin, and new section editor boi Nate Crowley.

notes.title: Our favourite games at EGX Rezzed 2019
notes.content:
The staff of RPS were rambling around Rezzed last week, like a troop of rowdy baboons. We were inspecting the games of our yearly show and rubbing our chins, going hmmm with the pensiveness of an art critic on the toilet. I m saying we were being judgey monkeys.
